meta.description: Search Docker Hub and browse the most popular official images.

empty.title: No popular images right now
empty.description: Docker Hub didn't return any results. Try again in a moment.

empty.title: No results
empty.description: Try a different search, or clear the filters.

state.retryIn_one: You can try again in {{count}} second.
state.retryIn_other: You can try again in {{count}} seconds.

not_found.title: Page not found
not_found.description: This page doesn't exist. Go back to Explore to search for an image.

repo_not_found.title: Repository not found
repo_not_found.description: It may have been removed, renamed or made private. Check the name, or go back to Explore to search for it.

unavailable.title: Docker Hub is unavailable
unavailable.description: We can't reach Docker Hub right now and have no saved copy of this page. Try again in a moment.

rate_limited.title: Too many requests
rate_limited.description: You've sent a lot of requests in a short time. Wait a few seconds, then try again.

unexpected.title: Something went wrong
unexpected.description: An unexpected error stopped this page from loading. Try again, or go back to Explore.

degraded.title: Showing saved data.
degraded.description: We couldn't refresh it just now, so it may be out of date. Try again in a minute for the latest.

suggestions.label: Suggestions
suggestions.empty: No suggestions for “{{query}}”. Press Enter to search anyway.
suggestions.error: Suggestions are unavailable right now. Press Enter to search.
suggestions.count_one: {{count}} suggestion available. Use the up and down arrow keys to browse.
suggestions.count_other: {{count}} suggestions available. Use the up and down arrow keys to browse.

results.title: Results for “{{query}}”
results.capped: Docker Hub lists only the first {{max}} results without sign-in. Add words to your search or a filter to find the others.

legacy.title: Showing basic results.
legacy.description: Docker Hub's full search isn't answering as expected, so these results are in best-match order and some details, such as logos, are missing.

empty.title: No results for “{{query}}”
empty.description: Check the spelling or try fewer words.
empty.descriptionFiltered: Check the spelling, try fewer words, or clear the filters.

pastEnd.title: No results on this page
pastEnd.description: This search has fewer pages. Its results start on page 1.

footer.disclaimer: Repository data comes from Docker Hub. Danny's Dockers is not affiliated with or endorsed by Docker, Inc.

empty.title: No overview yet
empty.description: The publisher hasn't written an overview for this repository. Its tags may still tell you what you need.

filter.label: Filter tags by name
filter.invalid: Tag names use only letters, digits, “_”, “.” and “-”.

platforms.caption: Platforms of {{tag}}
platforms.copyLabel: Copy docker pull by digest for {{tag}} on {{platform}}
platforms.copyTagLabel: Copy docker pull by digest for {{tag}}, all platforms
platforms.empty: Docker Hub lists no per-platform images for this tag.

tags.capped: Docker Hub lists only the first {{max}} tags without sign-in. Filter by name to find the others.

empty.title: No tags yet
empty.description: This repository has no tags to pull yet. Its overview may say how to get the image.

noMatch.title: No tags match “{{name}}”
noMatch.description: Check the spelling, or clear the filter to see every tag.

copy.manualAnnouncement: Couldn't copy automatically. The text is selected: press Ctrl+C, or Command+C on a Mac, to copy it.
